meta.name: autoskill
meta.description: Observe the user's screen via screenpipe, detect repeated research workflows, match them against existing scientific-agent-skills, and draft new skills (or composition recipes that chain existing ones) for the patterns not yet covered. Use when the user asks to analyze their recent work and propose skills based on what they actually do. Requires the screenpipe daemon (https://github.com/screenpipe/screenpipe) running locally on port 3030 — the skill has no other data source and will refuse to run if screenpipe is unreachable. All detection runs locally; only redacted cluster summaries reach the LLM.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 观察你的屏幕操作,自动找出重复流程并生成新技能建议
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望助手能根据你日常操作自动沉淀成可复用的技能
copy.tagline_en: Watch your screen, find repeated workflows, auto-suggest new skills
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your agent to turn your daily habits into reusable skills

howto.what: 装上后,它会读取本机 screenpipe 记录的屏幕时间线,找出你反复进行的研究工作流,与仓库里已有技能比对,产出可审阅、可编辑的技能草稿或组合配方。
howto.when: 当你明确要求分析自己最近的工作、并据此提出新技能建议时触发;需要本机 screenpipe 守护进程在 3030 端口运行,连不上就拒绝执行。

say.text: 分析我昨天的工作,看看哪些重复流程还没做成技能
先跑一遍 --plan,让我看看会分析哪段时间线
say.note: 只输出 plan.md,不调用 LLM

say.text: 把这份提案提升为正式技能,名字叫 zotero-pubmed-helper
say.note: 移入 skills/<名称>/,不覆盖同名技能

howto.what_en: Once installed, it reads the screen timeline captured locally by screenpipe, finds the research workflows you repeat, compares them against existing skills in the repo, and drafts reviewable skill or composition proposals.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you explicitly ask it to analyze your recent work and propose skills from it. It requires the local screenpipe daemon on port 3030 and refuses to run if unreachable.

say_en.text: Analyze yesterday's work and find repeated flows not yet covered by a skill
Run it in --plan mode first so I can see which timeline gets analyzed
say_en.note: Prints only plan.md, no LLM call

say_en.text: Promote that proposal into a real skill named zotero-pubmed-helper
say_en.note: Moves it to skills/<name>/, never overwriting
